Hostopia's white-label Domains platform lets you sell and manage domains under your brand, then seamlessly attach email, websites, SSL, and marketing services as customers grow.

features.heading: A Complete Domain Platform — Under Your Brand
features.intro: White-label search, registration, management, and upsell — fully branded with your logo, URL, and pricing. Hostopia runs the registrar infrastructure so you can focus on selling, bundling, and growing ARPU.

cards.title: Smart Domain Search & Registration
cards.body: Intelligent search with smart suggestions when first choices are taken, 24+ TLDs, flexible 1–10 year terms, and premium domains from trusted secondary markets.

cards.title: Integrated Domain-Based Email
cards.body: Professional email tied to the customer's domain activates immediately after registration — the highest-attach service in the portfolio, and the one that locks customers in for years.

cards.title: Full Domain Management
cards.body: DNS settings, forwarding, auto-renewals, expiration tracking, and bulk domain transfers — everything SMBs and partners need from a single branded dashboard.

cards.title: Right-Time Engagement Triggers
cards.body: Automated in-app and email prompts after domain purchase — "Add email," "Create a website," "Secure with SSL" — driving upsell at the moment of highest buyer intent.

cards.title: Registrar-Grade Security
cards.body: WHOIS privacy, transfer locks, two-factor authentication, and registrar-grade protections. Domains stay safe without customers having to think about it.

cards.title: Global TLD Coverage
cards.body: Operations across 34 countries and 14 languages give you the geographic coverage to sell local TLDs anywhere your partner footprint extends.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Your Easiest Path to Acquisition — and Your Best Lever for Retention
partnerAdvantage.intro: Domains are the lowest-cost, highest-attach entry point in digital services. Every registration is an opportunity to start a multi-product relationship that compounds into years of recurring revenue.

items.title: Anchor customers from day one
items.body: The domain is the most critical digital asset an SMB owns. When it lives on your platform, your brand is embedded at the foundation of their online presence — every website, every email, every integration points back to you.

items.title: Drive natural upsell with proven sequencing
items.body: Domain → email → website → SSL → ecommerce → marketing. The attach sequence is proven, and right-time engagement triggers automate the motion. Customers buy what they need, when they need it, without a sales call.

items.title: Reduce churn structurally
items.body: Migrating a domain is high-friction. Customers with a domain, email, and website on your platform have three reasons to stay — not just one. Every attached product multiplies the switching cost.

items.title: Skip the registrar build
items.body: Hostopia provides registrar infrastructure, DNS, management tools, and operations across 34 countries and 14 languages. You own the brand, the pricing, and the commercial model — with none of the engineering lift.

lifecycleFit.heading: The Starting Point for Every SMB Journey
lifecycleFit.intro: Domains sit at the very start of your lifecycle framework — the first product an SMB buys, and the anchor that connects everything else in the portfolio.

steps.title: Build a Brand
steps.body: Register the domain and activate domain-based email. This is where the relationship begins — and where your brand gets planted at the foundation of the SMB's digital identity.

steps.title: Get Online
steps.body: Add a website with Online Presence Builder, DIFM Website Design, or Custom Website Development, all tied to the domain already in your platform.

steps.title: Get Found
steps.body: Layer on SEO, directory listings, and reputation management to drive discoverability.

steps.title: Grow
steps.body: Expand into ecommerce, email marketing, and advanced digital services as the business scales.

lifecycleFit.positioning: Position domains as the "start here" product — the low-cost, high-attach entry point that feeds website, email, security, and marketing upsell across the entire SMB lifecycle.

cta.headline: Ready to Turn Domains into Your Next Growth Engine?
cta.body: Connect with Hostopia to launch your branded domain platform, bundle domains with email and web services, and turn every registration into a long-term SMB relationship.
